svg.title: Manual pose, image-based affine and optional landmark refinement
svg.desc: Read the three upper panels from left to right: set a similarity pose, use the selected image channels to fit an Elastix affine, and review the resulting moving-to-fixed pixel map G. The reviewed map branches either through two clearly separated choices: keep the global alignment and proceed to common review, or refine with landmarks before that same review. Six displayed landmark pairs define the schematic TPS exactly; the global affine is defined independently. The same contours, numbered pairs and coordinate grid are transformed consistently throughout. Hollow blue points are after G and filled teal points are their fixed matches. The local correction panel applies the solved TPS to a regular grid in the globally aligned coordinate frame; it displays the same six landmarks after they reach their fixed matches. Df converts fixed pixels to micrometres. Both choices join at the final overlay review and save action. No registration is run and no acquired image is shown.

g.text: Fit local TPS in fixed µm
